description: A performance testing script for the core.fsmonitor feature in Git, involving setup, configuration, and execution of various performance tests with different fsmonitor configurations and external dependencies like Watchman.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE is set, creating a directory and setting environment variables for performance tracing.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting GIT_TRACE2_PERF if tracing was enabled.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of files in a directory named after the number.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a series of Git commands to set up repository state, configure features, and verify conditions, with success expectation.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the environment for fsmonitor hook testing, including setting up integration scripts based on the presence of Watchman.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests with optional cache dropping based on environment variable.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Executes a series of performance tests for different git status and diff commands under various fsmonitor configurations.
